column3: “On the altar” is rendered “beside the altar”; “posterity” is rendered “the rest of them,” and “escapee” “refugee.”
“Snake” is rendered “serpent,” and “bottom of the sea” “floor of the sea.”
“The earth” is rendered “the land,” and “the River” “the Nile”; “melted” is rendered “melts.”
“Cushites” is rendered “Ethiopia,” and “people of Israel” “sons of Israel”; “Aram” is rendered “the Arameans.”
“Bring near and meet through us” is rendered “overtake or confront us.”
“Their breaches” and “his ruins” are both rendered with “its.”
“Dispossess” is rendered “possess”; “which my name is called on them” is rendered “who are called by My name.”
“Approach” is rendered “overtake”; “flow with it” (melt) is rendered “be dissolved.”
“Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the captivity,” and “desolated” “ruined.”
